jobs.snippet:
Fresher / Intern Data Analysts - Financial Services - Hanoi Office - Ha Noi, VN

# Fresher / Intern Data Analysts - Financial Services - Hanoi Office

Ha Noi, VN

USD 69K-123K (estimate) Entry-level I

futureYou.personTheyWillBecome: You will become a trusted Financial Data Analyst or Business Intelligence Analyst at a mid-tier Vietnamese bank or fintech company, fluent in SQL and Python, capable of building production-grade analytics solutions that directly reduce financial risk, improve operational efficiency, and drive business decisions. Your unique combination of accounting expertise and technical data skills will make you invaluable for translating complex financial workflows into scalable, automated analytics systems that finance teams depend on daily.
futureYou.achievementSummary: By the end of this roadmap, you will have: (1) mastered intermediate SQL and Python with 3+ production-grade portfolio projects demonstrating real business impact; (2) delivered 2 end-to-end analytics solutions for actual organizations that measurably improved financial reporting or operational efficiency; (3) secured and excelled in a junior Financial Data Analyst or BI Analyst role at a tier-1 Vietnamese bank earning 1.5M-2.2M VND/month; (4) built a professional network of 20+ analytics professionals and domain experts in Vietnamese financial services; (5) established yourself as a subject matter expert in financial data automation, positioning yourself for mid-level roles within 3-4 years.

phases.goal: Deepen SQL and Python proficiency to intermediate level and build first production-grade portfolio project with measurable business impact to establish credibility for junior analyst roles.
actions: Complete Advanced SQL course (Mode Analytics + DataCamp Advanced SQL track): 6 weeks, focus on window functions, CTEs, subqueries, query optimization, and performance tuning. Build 5 mini-projects solving real financial accounting scenarios (reconciliation logic, balance sheet aggregations, inter-company transaction matching).

Complete intermediate Python for data analysis (DataCamp or Coursera): 8 weeks, mastering pandas, numpy, data cleaning, and automation. Build one capstone project: automate a repetitive financial reconciliation or GL closing task you previously performed manually in Excel, document time saved and accuracy improvement.

Rebuild your 2 existing Power BI dashboards with full documentation: write a 2-page case study for each (problem statement, data sources, transformations, business impact, user feedback). If dashboards are internal-only, seek 3-5 users and collect written testimonials on business value delivered.

Contribute to 1 open-source analytics or Python financial library (e.g., pypfm, financial analysis libraries on GitHub): submit 2-3 meaningful pull requests (bug fixes, feature improvements, documentation). This demonstrates code quality and collaboration ability to employers.

Create a professional portfolio website or GitHub repo showcasing all 3 projects (SQL, Python automation, Power BI dashboards) with clear problem statements, methodology, code snippets, and results. Include links to live dashboards or exported reports.

Attend 2 local Hanoi data analytics meetups or webinars (Vietnam Analytics Community, Data Science Hanoi groups) and connect with 5-10 professionals on LinkedIn. Document 1 key insight or lesson learned from each event in a brief reflection post.
skills: Intermediate SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization, index awareness)
Intermediate Python for data analytics (pandas, data cleaning, automation scripting)
Financial domain modeling in SQL (GL structures, reconciliation logic, inter-company transactions)
Portfolio documentation and storytelling (translating technical work into business impact)
Basic code collaboration and GitHub workflow
phases.milestone: Portfolio with 3 complete, documented projects (1 SQL-based analysis, 1 Python automation script, 1 Power BI dashboard) publicly available on GitHub or portfolio site, each with measurable business metric (time saved, accuracy improved, or user adoption rate). LinkedIn profile updated with portfolio link and 10+ new analytics connections.

phases.goal: Secure and excel in a junior Financial Data Analyst or BI Analyst role at a Vietnamese bank or fintech, build production analytics experience, and develop intermediate cloud and ETL skills to position for mid-level advancement.
actions: Target and apply for 5-10 junior Financial Data Analyst or BI Analyst roles at banks listed in job postings (ABBank, GPBank, SHB, VPBank, MB Ageas Life). Customize each application to highlight accounting background, SQL/Python proficiency, and 1 portfolio project most relevant to their financial domain. Aim to start role by month 8.

Upon securing role, document your first 3 projects within the company with the same rigor as portfolio projects: problem statement, your solution approach, technologies used, business outcome. Build internal case studies to use for future promotions and external credibility.

Learn cloud data warehouse basics (BigQuery or Snowflake): enroll in a 4-week course focusing on data modeling, SQL query performance at scale, and integration with Power BI. Complete 2 practice projects migrating existing Excel/SQL analysis to cloud warehouse.

Develop intermediate statistics skills: take a 6-week course in statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and basic forecasting (Coursera Statistics for Business or DataCamp). Apply these skills to 1 project at your workplace (e.g., analyze transaction patterns, forecast financial metrics, or run a simple A/B test).

Build a reusable Python ETL framework or data pipeline: create a modular Python script (or use Apache Airflow basics) that automates daily/weekly data ingestion, cleaning, and transformation. Implement in your workplace if possible; otherwise, build as a portfolio project using public financial datasets.

Mentor 1-2 junior employees or interns on SQL and Power BI basics. Mentoring reinforces your own knowledge, builds leadership credibility, and expands your professional network internally and externally.
skills: Intermediate to Advanced SQL (complex joins, stored procedures, performance tuning)
Production analytics workflow and stakeholder management
Cloud data warehouse fundamentals (BigQuery or Snowflake architecture, query optimization)
Statistical analysis and hypothesis testing for business metrics
Basic ETL design and Python automation at production scale
Technical communication and project documentation for non-technical stakeholders
phases.milestone: Employed as Financial Data Analyst or BI Analyst at a Vietnamese bank or fintech for 6+ months with 2 documented production projects showing measurable business impact (e.g., 20% improvement in reporting speed, $50K cost savings from automation, improved data accuracy). Completed cloud data warehouse and statistics coursework with 2 capstone projects. At least 1 internal project deployed using cloud warehouse or production Python script.

phases.goal: Advance to mid-level or senior Business Data Analyst / Senior BI Analyst role, establish thought leadership in financial analytics, and build strategic influence within your organization or move to a leadership track.
actions: Pursue advanced analytics specialization based on company needs and your interests: machine learning for financial forecasting, advanced data modeling and dimensional design, or financial crime detection analytics. Choose 1 specialization and complete a 10-week advanced course plus 1 significant capstone project demonstrating expertise.

Lead a cross-functional analytics initiative at your company: partner with finance, operations, or risk teams to design and build an enterprise-scale reporting solution (e.g., unified financial dashboard, predictive risk model, automated anomaly detection). Document the full journey: requirements gathering, data architecture, technical implementation, change management, and business outcomes.

Present 2-3 technical talks at Vietnamese data analytics or fintech conferences or local meetups: share a case study, lessons learned, or technical deep-dive from your work. Examples: 'Scaling Financial Analytics on BigQuery,' 'Automating GL Reconciliation with Python,' 'Building Real-Time Risk Dashboards for Banks.'

Achieve AWS or Google Cloud Certification (Data Analytics or Associate Cloud Engineer level): demonstrates credibility in cloud infrastructure and opens doors to higher-paying roles at tech-forward companies. Pursue this by end of year 3.

Build and publish 1 open-source analytics tool or library relevant to financial data processing: could be a Python package for financial statement parsing, a SQL template library for common GL tasks, or a Power BI template for bank-specific KPIs. Promote on GitHub and LinkedIn; this establishes you as a technical authority.

Transition to a leadership or specialist role: either move into a senior individual contributor track (Senior Data Analyst / Principal Analyst) leading technical projects and mentoring juniors, or pivot to analytics leadership (Analytics Manager, Head of BI). Advocate for promotion internally or target mid-level roles at other tier-1 companies with 20-30% higher compensation.
skills: Advanced analytics specialization (machine learning, dimensional modeling, financial risk analytics, or data governance)
Enterprise data architecture and ETL design at production scale
Cloud platform expertise (AWS, GCP, or Azure) with formal certification
Technical leadership and cross-functional project management
Thought leadership and public speaking (conference talks, published articles, community contributions)
Strategic business acumen: translating analytics into executive-level business strategy
phases.milestone: Promoted to mid-level or senior analyst role (Senior Business Data Analyst, Senior BI Analyst, or Principal Analytics Engineer) at tier-1 Vietnamese bank or fintech, or hired into equivalent role at another company with 20-30% salary increase (1.8M-2.8M VND/month+). Completed 1 advanced analytics specialization and deployed 1 enterprise-scale project. Published 1 open-source tool, given 2+ public talks, and earned 1 cloud certification. Established as a recognized technical expert in financial data analytics within Vietnamese fintech/banking ecosystem.
